tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Buttons, links, accents, the focus ring and the active item in the HR sidebar and candidate top bar. White text on it 6.6:1; as text 6.3:1 on surface and 5.8:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons; link hover.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest brand shade: landing gradients, the first funnel bar, footer band. White text 13.8:1.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Gradient mid-stop, score-ring track accent, lighter chart bars (label outside the bar). Never text.

tokens.name: primary-faint
tokens.usage: Gradient light stop, drag-over outlines, decorative blobs. Never text.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Highlights, selected rows, Shortlisted badge, AI note (with a primary-faint border, since it is close to surface-page), tags. Text on it: on-primary-tint.

tokens.name: on-primary-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-tint (9.6:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-hover, primary-deep, nav-bg and danger fills.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and main text on surface (16.2:1) and surface-page (14.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, meta lines, table headers on surface (6.2:1), surface-page (5.7:1), surface-sunken (5.4:1) and primary-tint (5.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside fields, which are filled with surface (4.8:1). Never on surface-page.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast rules).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Warm sand 1px borders for cards, tables and dividers. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Resting border of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons: 4:1 on surface and 3.5:1 on surface-page so control edges stay visible.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Warm cream page background on every work page, HR and candidate.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Light cream for cards, tables, dialogs, inputs and menus. Never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Deeper cream for row hover, table headers, chips, disabled fills, skeleton base and the hint box inside cards.

tokens.name: surface-skeleton-shine
tokens.usage: Highlight band of the skeleton shimmer.

tokens.name: surface-column

tokens.name: nav-line

tokens.name: nav-text-muted
